sections.title: Why study Civil Engineering in France?
sections.lead: \\Study Civil engineering is longstanding traditions in France\\, including in buildings, transport infrastructure, water management, public works and urban development.

items: \\Education oriented on engineering:\\ Get to know \\structural mechanics, construction materials, soil mechanics, hydraulics and building technology.

sections.title: Civil Engineering Courses in France
sections.lead: \\Civil engineering courses in France\\ deal with the planning, design, construction and maintenance of infrastructure and the built environment.

items: Some common fields of study include:
\\Civil Engineering:\\ Principles of construction, engineering materials, surveying, and project design.
\\Structural Engineering:\\ Structural analysis, reinforced concrete, steel structures, building safety.
\\Construction Engineering:\\ Construction methods, planning, cost estimating and project management.
\\Geotechnical Engineering:\\ Soil mechanics, foundation, ground investigation, slope stability.
\\Transportation Engineering:\\ Roads, rail, transportation infrastructure and mobility systems.
\Water and Environmental Engineering:\\ Water resources, drainage, hydraulics, sustainable infrastructure.
\\Urban Infrastructure:\\ Public spaces, utilities, urban planning and infrastructure development.
\\Construction Management:\\ Project scheduling, contracts, cost control and site coordination.
Duration of program
\\Bachelor's degree or Licence:\\ usually 3 years long.
\\French engineering-school route:\\ usually 5 years after secondary school.
Depending on program rules, some engineering schools may confer an intermediate institutional bachelor's-level qualification after three years.

sections.title: Eligibility to study Civil Engineering UG in France
sections.lead: These \\eligibility requirements in France for civil engineering\\ are typically demanded from international applicants:

items: completing secondary school successfully, which is similar to the French \baccalauréat.
a strong academic record in both physics and mathematics.
Chemistry or other disciplines if necessary.
English language proficiency for courses taught in English, or French language proficiency for courses taught in French.
Any admission test, interview or other academic assessment required.

Class 12 with mathematics and physics is often relevant for \\undergraduate civil engineering admission in France\\ for \\Indian students\. Different institutions have different minimum grades and subject combinations.

Passport is valid

Selective programs may assess \\mathematics and physics preparation\\, academic performance, motivation and suitability for engineering studies

sections.title: France UG Admission Process for Civil Engineering
sections.lead: The typical \\admission process for undergraduate civil engineering in France\\ is as follows:

items: 1. \\Select your field of study: focus on structural, construction, transport, geotechnics or environmental infrastructure.
2. \\Shortlist universities:\\ Compare the content of the programs, the type of degree, the language of instruction, fees and the accreditation.
3. \\Check the admissions route:\\ Find out if the school accepts direct applications or needs a national platform or \\Études en France procédure\.
4. \\Gather your documents:\\ Get your academic transcripts, passport information, language proficiency test results and motivation documents ready.
5. \\Submit your application:\\ Complete the application process by the specified deadline.
6. \\Last Steps:\\ Take an interview or entrance test if required.
7. \\Accept your offer:\\ Follow the institution's enrollment instructions.
8. \\Apply for a student visa:\\ After you have received the required admission documents, follow the relevant \\French student visa procedure\\

sections.title: Accreditation and recognition of civil engineering in France
sections.lead: \\In France, accreditation\\ Civil engineering is important when comparing a bachelor's program with an engineering-school diploma.

items: The \\Commission des titres d'ingénieurs (CTI)\\ evaluates qualifying engineering programs and authorizes institutions to award the French \diplôme d'ingénieur\ It is a different qualification, a three-year bachelor's degree.
Students should: Pre-enrolment
Check what qualification will be granted.
\\CTI accreditation\\ if they want a French engineering degree.
The qualification must be suitable for further education.
Check any requirements for professional registration or recognition in the country they intend to work.

faqs.q: \\Q1. Is it possible for Indian students to study Undergraduate Civil Engineering in France?\\
faqs.a: Yes. \\Indian students can do civil engineering in France\\ if they meet academic, language and application criteria, by applying to eligible bachelor's and engineering-school courses.

faqs.q: \\Q2. How long is the civil engineering bachelor's degree in France?\\
faqs.a: A \\civil engineering bachelor's degree\\ is usually a three-year program. A traditional \\ French engineering-school track \\ is usually five years post-high school .

faqs.q: \\Q3. Are courses in civil engineering in France taught in English?\\
faqs.a: Many of the traditional civil engineering engineering-school curricula are taught in French. There are some modules or exchange options taught in English, but students should verify that the entire degree is taught in English.

faqs.q: \\Q4. What is the cost of studying Civil Engineering undergraduate in France?
faqs.a: Depends on the institution. For the academic year \\2026-2027\\, the published differentiated fee for non-EU students governed by the rules of the relevant public institution is \\€2,902 per year at bachelor level. Fee schedules can differ from engineering school to engineering school.
